name: Cinematic story to shots and assets

nodes.name: idea
nodes.value: At sunrise, a young courier finds a glowing paper crane on her balcony, follows it through a quiet city, and discovers it is leading her to a hidden rooftop garden where her missing brother left one final message.

inputs.name: story
inputs.value: At sunrise, a young courier finds a glowing paper crane on her balcony, follows it through a quiet city, and discovers it is leading her to a hidden rooftop garden where her missing brother left one final message.

outputs.name: shots
outputs.value:
CONTINUITY BIBLE
- Characters: ELARA (Young courier, athletic build), BROTHER (Seen only in a stationary note/message)
- Location/background anchors: Elara's balcony (stone railing, cityscape view); Quiet city streets (cobblestone, narrow alleys); Hidden rooftop garden (overgrown vines, wooden trellis, stone planters).
- Props: Glowing paper crane (emits soft golden light), small weathered envelope.
- Wardrobe: Elara wears a canvas messenger bag and a teal utility vest over a tan linen shirt.
- Time/weather/light: Sunrise; clear sky; warm orange/gold directional light from the east.
- Screen direction: Elara moves mostly left to right through the city streets.

SEQUENCE
SHOT 01 | 4 sec | TITLE
Action: ELARA enters the frame on her balcony, leaning over the stone railing to look at the horizon.
Camera: Medium shot, eye level, 35mm, static.
Continuity: Stone balcony railing, sunrise orange light from the right.

SHOT 02 | 4 sec | TITLE
Action: A small paper crane, glowing with golden light, flutters onto the stone railing in front of Elara.
Camera: Close-up, low angle, 50mm, static.
Continuity: Stone railing, golden glow from the crane, sunrise light.

SHOT 03 | 4 sec | TITLE
Action: Elara reaches out her hand to touch the glowing paper crane.
Camera: Tight close-up, eye level, 85mm, slight push-in.
Continuity: Teal utility vest sleeve, golden glow on skin, sunrise light.

SHOT 04 | 3 sec | TITLE
Action: The paper crane lifts into the air and flies toward the city street below.
Camera: Medium shot, high angle, 35mm, tilt down following the crane.
Continuity: Balcony edge, city skyline in background, sunrise light.

SHOT 05 | 4 sec | TITLE
Action: Elara steps off her balcony onto a narrow stone staircase, following the glowing trail.
Camera: Full shot, low angle, 24mm, tracking shot moving backward as she descends.
Continuity: Stone stairs, teal utility vest, sunrise light from right.

SHOT 06 | 4 sec | TITLE
Action: Elara walks down a narrow cobblestone alleyway, eyes fixed on the glowing crane ahead.
Camera: Medium shot, eye level, 50mm, tracking side profile (left to right).
Continuity: Cobblestone street, narrow walls, sunrise light hitting buildings.

SHOT 07 | 4 sec | TITLE
Action: The paper crane zips around a corner of a brick building, leaving a faint golden trail.
Camera: Close-up, low angle, 35mm, pan right following the movement.
Continuity: Brick wall texture, golden light trail, sunrise light.

SHOT 08 | 4 sec | TITLE
Action: Elara stops at a street intersection and looks up toward a high rooftop.
Camera: Medium shot, low angle, 35mm, static.
Continuity: Cobblestone ground, messenger bag strap, sunrise light from behind.

SHOT 09 | 4 sec | TITLE
Action: The paper crane ascends vertically toward a lush, green rooftop terrace.
Camera: Long shot, low angle, 24mm, tilt up following the crane.
Continuity: Brick buildings, distant greenery on roof, sunrise light.

SHOT 10 | 3 sec | TITLE
Action: Elara climbs a wooden ladder leaning against the side of the rooftop garden.
Camera: Medium shot, eye level, 35mm, tracking shot moving up with her.
Continuity: Wooden ladder, teal utility vest, morning sun.

SHOT 11 | 4 sec | TITLE
Action: Elara steps onto the rooftop garden, surrounded by overgrown vines and stone planters.
Camera: Full shot, eye level, 35mm, tracking shot moving forward.
Continuity: Overgrown vines, wooden trellis, sunrise light from right.

SHOT 12 | 4 sec | TITLE
Action: The paper crane lands on a small wooden table in the center of the garden.
Camera: Close-up, high angle, 50mm, static.
Continuity: Wooden table, stone planters, golden glow.

SHOT 13 | 5 sec | TITLE
Action: Elara approaches the table and picks up a weathered envelope resting next to the crane.
Camera: Medium shot, eye level, 35mm, slow push-in.
Continuity: Wooden table, teal vest, sunrise light.

SHOT 14 | 5 sec | TITLE
Action: Elara opens the envelope to reveal a handwritten note from her brother.
Camera: Extreme close-up, top-down angle, 85mm, static.
Continuity: Weathered paper, handwritten text, golden glow from crane nearby.

SHOT 15 | 4 sec | TITLE
Action: Elara clutches the note to her chest, looking out over the sunrise city skyline.
Camera: Medium shot, side profile, 50mm, slow pull-back.
Continuity: Rooftop garden, messenger bag, bright orange sunrise light.
